name: EncryptedPdfError
where: src/parser/documentParser.ts when a password is required or wrong; src/crypto/keyDerivation.ts for the incorrect-password checks

name: FontNotEmbeddedError
where: src/core/pdfPage.ts drawText, when a font reference made by the library belongs to another document

name: ForeignPageError
where: adding a page of another document is a supported, tested route, so no condition is left to throw on

name: RemovePageFromEmptyDocumentError
where: src/core/pdfDocument.ts removePage on a document with no page

name: NoSuchFieldError
where: src/form/pdfForm.ts getTextField and the other typed getters, when the name is not a field

name: UnexpectedFieldTypeError
where: src/form/pdfForm.ts getTextField and the other typed getters, when the field has another type

name: MissingOnValueCheckError
where: src/form/fields/checkboxField.ts check(), when the appearance has no on state and the value is absent or Off

name: FieldAlreadyExistsError
where: src/form/pdfForm.ts createFieldDict, when a field of that name exists

name: InvalidFieldNamePartError
where: src/form/pdfForm.ts createFieldDict, when the name is empty or contains a period

name: FieldExistsAsNonTerminalError
where: created fields are flat and loaded field trees are not built yet, so no condition is left to throw on

name: RichTextFieldReadError
where: its only throw sites sit inside a catch-all in src/form/formFlatten.ts, so no caller ever sees the class

name: CombedTextLayoutError
where: src/form/fields/textField.ts setText, on a comb field with more characters than /MaxLen

name: ExceededMaxLengthError
where: src/form/fields/textField.ts setText, on a field with more characters than /MaxLen

name: InvalidPageSizeError
where: src/core/pdfDocument.ts addPage and insertPage, when the size is not finite or not positive

name: InvalidColorError
where: src/core/operators/color.ts rgb, cmyk and grayscale, when a component is outside 0..1

name: PluginError
where: src/plugins/pluginSystem.ts register, when a plugin of the same name is already registered

name: StreamingParseError
where: src/parser/streamingParser.ts, in place of the PdfParseError throws of the streaming parse

name: BatchProcessingError
where: src/batch/batchProcessor.ts, errorStrategy collect, in place of the AggregateError
